datasets.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
datasets.coverage: Registered organised manufacturing; industry-wise and State-wise; accounting years ending within the financial year
datasets.unit: source-defined monetary, count and ratio units
datasets.definitions: Covers registered manufacturing factories and provides input, output, value added, employment and asset measures using NIC 2008 and NPCMS classifications.
datasets.methodology: Annual establishment survey under the Collection of Statistics Act framework, with web-based collection, validation, non-response treatment and published tabulation methodology.
datasets.revision_policy: Published results and tables are retained by reference year; later releases or corrections must be recorded as new vintages.
datasets.licence: Official public data; redistribution subject to applicable MoSPI dissemination terms.

provenance.verification_basis: MoSPI National Metadata Structure identifies ASI coverage, classifications, annual frequency, access and methodology; 2023-24 summary results confirm published manufacturing aggregates.

datasets.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
datasets.coverage: National and State accounts, including GDP, GVA and industry-level aggregates; annual and quarterly estimates
datasets.unit: source-defined current-price and constant-price monetary units and growth rates
datasets.definitions: National accounts framework covering GDP, GVA, GSDP, national income, capital formation and savings by industry and institutional sector.
datasets.methodology: MoSPI National Accounts methodology using multiple primary and administrative sources; current series uses base year 2022-23.
datasets.revision_policy: National Accounts estimates are subject to revisions as improved and more comprehensive information becomes available.
datasets.licence: Official public data; redistribution subject to applicable MoSPI dissemination terms.
datasets.update_schedule: annual publication with quarterly estimates and releases

provenance.verification_basis: MoSPI announced the National Accounts Statistics - 2026 publication on 31 August 2026. The current 2022-23-base series and manufacturing growth/share values were independently cross-checked against official MoSPI/PIB material.

datasets.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
datasets.coverage: All-India industrial production, including Manufacturing sector; current series base 2022-23=100
datasets.definitions: Short-term composite indicator measuring changes in production volume of a basket of industrial products; manufacturing is a separately published sectoral index.
datasets.methodology: Current IIP series uses NIC 2008, a revised 2022-23 base, sectoral and item weights, and production data from designated source agencies.
datasets.revision_policy: Monthly releases contain quick estimates followed by revisions and final estimates according to the published revision cycle.
datasets.licence: Official public data; redistribution subject to applicable MoSPI dissemination terms.

provenance.verification_basis: MoSPI released the new IIP series with base 2022-23 on 1 June 2026 and identifies manufacturing as a sectoral index; official FAQ documents current base and revision policy.

datasets.publisher: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
datasets.coverage: India labour force, employment and unemployment; annual, quarterly and monthly outputs subject to survey design and release
datasets.definitions: Produces labour force participation rate, worker population ratio, unemployment rate and activity-status measures, including industry-of-work classifications.
datasets.methodology: Household sample survey using published PLFS concepts, definitions, sampling and estimation procedures. The 2025 design introduced changes to support high-frequency estimates.
datasets.revision_policy: Published survey estimates are versioned by survey year or release; methodological breaks must be retained and not silently bridged.
datasets.licence: Official public data; redistribution subject to applicable MoSPI dissemination terms.

provenance.verification_basis: MoSPI PLFS releases define LFPR, WPR and UR; official 2025 annual release documents the sampling-design change and retained concepts.

datasets.dataset_name: Union Budget and Demands for Grants
datasets.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
datasets.coverage: Union fiscal estimates, revised estimates, actuals and programme/department expenditure documents
datasets.definitions: Official Union Budget documents, including Annual Financial Statement, Demands for Grants and expenditure statements.
datasets.methodology: Statutory Union Budget accounting and budget-document presentation; individual statements define their own accounting scope.
datasets.revision_policy: Budget estimates, revised estimates and actual expenditure are separate stages and must remain distinct.
datasets.licence: Official public government documents; source-specific reproduction terms apply.

provenance.verification_basis: Official India Budget portal provides the 2026-27 Annual Financial Statement, Consolidated Fund statements and budget documents; spreadsheet notes identify PDFs as final where inconsistencies arise.

datasets.dataset_name: TRADESTAT Export Import Data Bank, Merchandise Trade
datasets.publisher: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India
datasets.coverage: Merchandise exports and imports by country, commodity, chapter, region and other trade dimensions; current portal coverage from 2017-18
datasets.unit: source-defined INR or USD trade values and quantities
datasets.definitions: Government Export Import Data Bank providing country-wise, commodity-wise, chapter-wise, region-wise and customised merchandise trade reports.
datasets.methodology: Official trade statistics sourced through DGCI&S and presented through the Department of Commerce data bank.
datasets.revision_policy: Trade values and classifications may be revised; the portal identifies revised/final status and classification changes by period.
datasets.licence: Official public data; source-specific terms apply.

provenance.verification_basis: Official TradeStat portal identifies trade types, report dimensions, available periods and update date; commodity pages document classification changes.

datasets.publisher: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
datasets.coverage: FDI equity and total inflow statistics by sector, country and State; cumulative and period-specific series from 2000 onward
datasets.definitions: Official FDI inflow statistics including equity inflow and total FDI inflow, with sector-wise, country-wise and State-wise tables.
datasets.methodology: DPIIT compilation using official FDI information, including RBI inputs; sector and State tables follow DPIIT publication classifications.
datasets.revision_policy: Provisional figures remain subject to reconciliation with RBI and later publication revisions.
datasets.licence: Official public data; source-specific reproduction terms apply.

provenance.verification_basis: DPIIT FDI Data Cell and 2026 official sector/sub-sector/state statements provide current sectoral FDI statistics through March 2026.

datasets.coverage: Macroeconomic, industrial, banking, financial, external-sector and socio-economic time series; series-dependent historical coverage
datasets.definitions: RBI data warehouse containing time-series publications and statistical series, including industrial statistics, banking, finance, public finance and external-sector data.
datasets.methodology: RBI statistical compilation and dissemination; individual series retain their own concepts, definitions and source notes.
datasets.revision_policy: Series are updated and revised according to the relevant RBI statistical release and source methodology.
datasets.licence: Official public data; source-specific terms apply.

provenance.verification_basis: RBI identifies DBIE as its data warehouse and provides time-series publications and downloadable statistical series; series-specific notes govern interpretation.

datasets.dataset_name: Order Books, Inventories and Capacity Utilisation Survey (OBICUS)
datasets.coverage: All-India manufacturing companies targeted by RBI's quarterly OBICUS survey; quarterly manufacturing capacity utilisation, order books and inventories
datasets.unit: per cent for capacity utilisation; source-defined units for order books and inventories
datasets.definitions: Quarterly RBI survey collecting new orders, backlog and pending orders, inventories and item-wise production relative to installed capacity from the targeted manufacturing-company panel; capacity utilisation is estimated from survey responses.
datasets.methodology: RBI OBICUS methodology. The survey has been conducted quarterly since 2008. Capacity utilisation is estimated from reported production relative to installed capacity; seasonally adjusted CU is separately calculated by RBI using X13-ARIMA-SEATS. Survey participation is voluntary and company-level data are confidential.
datasets.revision_policy: Published quarterly survey results and time-series files are retained by release; revisions or methodological changes must be recorded as new vintages where applicable.
datasets.licence: Official public RBI survey results; source-specific reproduction terms apply.

provenance.verification_basis: RBI official publications state that OBICUS has been conducted quarterly since 2008, describe the manufacturing survey variables and identify CU as estimated from responses; RBI releases separately publish CU and CU-SA.

datasets.coverage: Industrial sectors worldwide under ISIC Revision 4; manufacturing indicators including output, value added, employment, wages, establishments and gross fixed capital formation; current published coverage varies by country
datasets.unit: current national currency and USD for monetary values; counts and index values for other measures
datasets.definitions: Official industrial statistics compiled from national and regional statistical offices and other official sources, organised using ISIC Rev. 4.
datasets.methodology: UNIDO harmonisation and metadata collection prioritising comparability across countries and time; monetary values are presented in current prices and USD conversions.
datasets.revision_policy: Database is updated annually; country-level coverage and years vary with official source availability.
datasets.licence: Official UNIDO database; access and reuse subject to UNIDO terms.

provenance.verification_basis: UNIDO database description documents INDSTAT Revision 4 scope, indicators, ISIC Rev. 4 classification, official source collection, annual frequency and coverage.
